description: VYBE Music v4.1.8 — Social Video Music Identifier with Continuous Radio, Brand-New Transparent VYBE Update Dialog Logo, Native System Capsule Integration, and Real-Time Cross-Device Admin Push Notifications.

announcement.title: Welcome To VYBE Music
announcement.message: Welcome to VYBE Music v4.1.8! Enjoy infinite ad-free music, intelligent video sound identification with continuous radio, and sleek transparent VYBE branding.

changelog.title: Instagram Reels, TikTok & Shorts Music Identifier
items: Direct Share-to-Identify: Share any video link from Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts directly into VYBE Music
Continuous Radio Playback: Tapping Play Now automatically initializes infinite radio playback matching the shared song style
Smart Video Sound Matcher: Crawls real audio metadata while gracefully falling back to built-in sound listening or manual search if no track is tagged
Clean Bottom Sheet Dialog: Non-intrusive bottom sheet displays identified track details, artwork, artist, and original audio source

changelog.title: Transparent VYBE Update Dialog Branding
items: Brand-New Transparent VYBE Logo: Replaced legacy Google badge with high-visibility transparent VYBE logo without background
Streamlined Update Modal: Clean official update indicator with quick single-tap OTA download

changelog.title: Native Android System Media Integration
items: Native System Capsule Support: Seamlessly cooperates with realme Mini Capsule, OnePlus Fluid Cloud, HyperOS, and Android system media notifications
Clean Top Bar Branding: Preserves complete unhindered visibility of the VYBE logo, together icon, and account avatar

changelog.title: Real-Time Cross-Device Admin Push Notifications
items: Instant Multi-Phone Delivery: Notifications sent from Admin Screen broadcast immediately across all member devices via pub/sub cloud relay
Automatic Catch-Up Sync: Offline devices automatically receive queued announcements on app startup or periodic background sync
